name: Object Diagram
description: Object Diagram describes specific instances of a class and their attribute values at a given runtime moment. It is like a data snapshot to verify or illustrate a Class Diagram.
purpose: Illustrate complex data structures at a specific point in time, verify relationships, or describe mock data.
bestFor: Illustrate complex data structures at a specific snapshot
Describe mock data for customers, testers, or developers
Verify recursive or complex relationships (tree, graph)
Explain data scenarios causing errors that need analysis
notSuitableFor: Design general class blueprint → use Class Diagram
Describe processing flow over time → use Sequence / Activity Diagram
Describe object lifecycle states → use State Machine Diagram
useCases: Select specific object and corresponding class
Assign actual attribute values at snapshot

elements.name: Snapshot Context
elements.description: Context or point in time of data

confusableWith.difference: Class Diagram describes types/classes; Object Diagram describes specific objects and actual values.
Object Diagram focuses on data structure; Communication Diagram focuses on messages between objects.
